parity: Observable only for a caller that supplies its own Agent or CacheWarmer: Pi lets that caller read the runner through the cell it created; Go gives the same caller Session.ExtensionRunner(). The Session's own Agent and warmer, the CLI and the SDK entry points behave as in Pi (D113; TestNewAgentSessionDrivesTheSuppliedAgentAndChainsItsHooks, TestNewAgentSessionDrivesTheSuppliedCacheWarmer).
maintainability: No second source of truth: the Session replaces its runner on reload and on session replacement, and a cell shared with the caller would have to be kept in step with it. Go closes over the Session in the hooks it installs.
performance: None: Pi assigns the cell on every runtime build (agent-session.ts:3644-3645); Go does no extra work.

parity: A Go error carries no captured stack (D103). Every Pi reader of Error.stack takes an arbitrary error and none is specific to CredentialSynchronizationError (crash-log.ts:135, agent-session.ts:1608, runner.ts:316 and later sites); the message, name, providerId, operation, credential and cause match Pi (TestCredentialSynchronizationErrorMatchesPi, 200 probes).
maintainability: No Go code: the runner and crash-log paths that print a stack read the stack of whatever error they hold, through extension.ErrorStack.
performance: None: Pi captures a stack at construction; Go skips the capture.

parity: Pi's optional eventBus argument has no Go counterpart: the Extension Host routes pi.events between extension processes, so a caller cannot supply a bus (D117). The discovery the function performs (locations, order, entries, links, deduplication) equals Pi's: TestDiscoverExtensionPathsMatchPi compares 300 seeded trees with Pi.
maintainability: A context.Context replaces the unused parameter; accepting an eventBus the host ignores would hide the difference.
performance: None: discovery is the same filesystem walk; loading runs in the Extension Host as D19 records.
